Messages.Body:
i have a feeling i cheated on Wednesday, but i just want to check.

i bled using Sheldon. Mark Telepathically countered. i played Spying
Mission at superior, for +2 bleed next time i bled.

At the time i reasoned that if you can play a Taste of Vitae to gain no
blood then you should be able to play a spying mission even when you are
removing no pool. But on reflection, i now think that the OPPORTUNITY to
play the card didn't exist, because the card text says "instead of
removing pool ...." ergo if i don't remove pool i can't play it.

Still a bit confused about this, and welcome clarification.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.
